slides.title: "No" doesn't need *a speech.*
slides.sub: On the long explanation that follows a no.

slides.title: Notice the essay
slides.body: Next time you turn something down, listen to what comes after the no. The reasons, the apologies, the backstory.

slides.title: Who is it for?
slides.body: Often the long version isn't for them. It's to keep them from being upset, or to win permission you don't need.

slides.title: Try the short one
slides.body: "I can't make it, but thanks for asking." Then stop. Let the quiet sit for a second.

slides.title: Notice what comes up
slides.body: After a short no, what do you feel? Relief, guilt, the urge to explain? That feeling is worth getting to know.
